data.name: Kome-Pachi
data.detailed_description:
Super Rice Milling God: Gokuuma Light-M is a fast-paced pachinko simulator with a unique rice theme.

Match three numbers to trigger exciting Reach sequences, hit the jackpot, and chain bonus rounds to earn massive amounts of milled rice.

The simple rules make it easy for anyone to jump in and play, while strategic timing and ever-changing game flow keep every session exciting.

With satisfying jackpot moments and endless replayability, you'll find yourself coming back for "just one more game!"

◆ A Rice Mill... and Pachinko?!

Pachinko balls become rice!

When you hit Fever Mode, a giant rice milling machine roars to life, spinning at full speed as streams of freshly milled white rice pour out in spectacular fashion.

Watch the screen fill with flying rice and enjoy over-the-top visual effects that make you feel as if you're operating a real rice mill.

It's a one-of-a-kind pachinko experience where the thrill of hitting the jackpot meets the satisfying excitement of producing mountains of delicious rice!

◆ Easy to Play with Automatic Left & Right Shooting!

New to pachinko? No problem!

Super Rice Milling God: Gokuuma Light-M is designed with simple rules that make it easy for anyone to jump in and start having fun.

The game also features an Auto Left/Right Shooting Mode, which automatically switches between left and right shooting whenever needed.

No need to worry about complicated controls or manual shot switching—just sit back and enjoy the excitement of Reach sequences, Jackpots, and spectacular Fever events!

◆ Exciting Rice-Themed Reach Animations!

The more you play, the more you'll discover colorful and exciting animations that celebrate the beauty, richness, and charm of rice!

Every Reach sequence brings unique rice-themed visuals, while the thrill of hitting the jackpot is amplified by the satisfying sound of rice pouring from the milling machine.

Enjoy a one-of-a-kind spectacle that combines the excitement of pachinko with the irresistible appeal of rice!

◆ Aim for the Ultimate Rice Jackpot!

With flashy effects and fast-paced gameplay, you can jump in for a quick session anytime.

Your goal? Achieve the legendary 10,000-Rice Jackpot and climb to the top of the leaderboard with your biggest win!

Fire up the rice mill and let the rice overflow!

Can you reach the legendary 10,000-Rice Jackpot?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10
  • Processor: Core i3-8100 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti / RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek ALC3254
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800H with Radeon Graphics (3.20 GHz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 SUPER / RX 5500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek ALC3254
